hooks.command: cwd=$(python3 -c 'import json, re, sys; i = json.load(sys.stdin); c = i.get("tool_input", {}).get("command", ""); print(i.get("cwd") or ".") if re.search(r"\bgit\b(\s+-C\s+\S+)?\s+push\b", c) else sys.exit(1)') || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; git -C "$root" fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null; python3 "$root/scripts/notes-gate.py" --pending
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the next release has its notes
